description: Options Chain: Add basic options chain data exploration with navigable table, expiration switching, and calls/puts toggle. Uses yfinance options API for free options data without subscription services.
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
Follow established patterns - reuse NewsPanel navigation and QuotePanel state patterns
Apply learnings from AGENTS.md and previous widget implementations
Options data comes from yfinance - no external dependencies needed

background.optionsOverview: Options are financial derivatives that give the holder the right (but not obligation) to buy or sell an underlying asset at a specified price within a specific time period.

optionsTerminology.call: Right to BUY at strike price (bullish bet)
optionsTerminology.put: Right to SELL at strike price (bearish bet)
optionsTerminology.strike: The price at which option can be exercised
optionsTerminology.premium: Price paid for the option contract (bid/ask)
optionsTerminology.itm: In The Money - option has intrinsic value
optionsTerminology.otm: Out of The Money - option has no intrinsic value
optionsTerminology.iv: Implied Volatility - market's expectation of price movement

available: ticker.options - list of available expiration dates
strike, bid, ask, lastPrice, volume, openInterest
notAvailable: Greeks (delta, theta, gamma, vega) - would require Black-Scholes calculation
Historical options data - only current chain available

existingPatterns: NewsPanel - j/k navigation, selected item highlighting, state machine (empty/loading/success/error)
ChartPanel - togglable panel integration, keybindings in app.py

userStories.title: Create options service - fetch expirations
acceptanceCriteria: New file: viper/services/options.py
Create async function: fetch_option_expirations(ticker: str) -> list[str] | OptionsError
Uses yfinance ticker.options to get available expiration dates
Returns list of date strings in YYYY-MM-DD format
Returns OptionsError dataclass on failure (invalid ticker, no options, network error)
OptionsError has ticker and error_message fields
Handle edge case: ticker exists but has no options (some ETFs, penny stocks)
100% test coverage with mocked yfinance responses
Tests: valid ticker with options, valid ticker without options, invalid ticker
Export from viper/services/__init__.py
userStories.notes: Foundation for options feature. yfinance returns tuple of date strings from ticker.options property. Convert to list and handle None/empty cases.

userStories.title: Create options service - fetch chain data
acceptanceCriteria: Create dataclass: OptionContract with fields: strike, bid, ask, last_price, volume, open_interest, implied_volatility, in_the_money
Create dataclass: OptionsChain with fields: ticker, expiration, calls (list[OptionContract]), puts (list[OptionContract])
Create async function: fetch_option_chain(ticker: str, expiration: str) -> OptionsChain | OptionsError
Uses yfinance ticker.option_chain(expiration) to get calls/puts DataFrames
Converts DataFrame rows to OptionContract dataclass instances
Handle None/NaN values in DataFrame (default to 0 for numeric fields)
Returns OptionsError if expiration not found or other error
100% test coverage with mocked yfinance responses
Tests: valid chain data, empty chain, invalid expiration, NaN handling
userStories.notes: yfinance option_chain returns namedtuple with .calls and .puts DataFrames. Each has columns: strike, bid, ask, lastPrice, volume, openInterest, impliedVolatility, inTheMoney.

userStories.title: Create OptionsChainPanel widget
acceptanceCriteria: New file: viper/widgets/options_panel.py
Class OptionsChainPanel extends Widget with can_focus = True
State machine: empty, loading, success, error (follow QuotePanel pattern)
Compose: header label, expiration selector, options table in VerticalScroll
Table columns: Strike, Bid, Ask, Last, Vol, OI, IV, ITM
Selected row highlighted (follow NewsPanel .selected class pattern)
ITM contracts highlighted in green, OTM in default color
Header shows: 'OPTIONS: {ticker} | {expiration} | CALLS' or 'PUTS'
Display loading state while fetching options data
Display error state if no options available for ticker
BINDINGS: j/k for row navigation (priority=True)
Method: load_options(ticker: str) - fetches expirations and first chain
Method: show_empty() - display 'No ticker selected' state
100% test coverage on widget states and navigation
Export from viper/widgets/__init__.py
userStories.notes: Follow NewsPanel pattern for j/k navigation and selection. State management follows QuotePanel. Table is simple Labels in Container, not DataTable widget (keeps it simple).

userStories.title: App integration - 'o' keybinding
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'o' keybinding to app.py BINDINGS: Binding('o', 'toggle_options', 'Options', show=False)
Create OptionsChainPanel instance in app compose()
Panel starts hidden (call hide() after mounting)
action_toggle_options() toggles panel visibility
When showing options panel: load options for current ticker if ticker exists
When hiding options panel: just hide, don't clear data
Options panel replaces multi-purpose panel area when visible (or shows alongside)
Track visibility: _options_panel_visible: bool = False
Only show options when a ticker is selected (not on initial empty state)
Add 'o' key to help_screen.py keybindings section
Test: 'o' toggles options panel on/off
Test: Options load when panel shown with valid ticker
Test: Panel shows empty state when no ticker selected
userStories.notes: 'o' for Options (mnemonic). Options panel can coexist with chart/news or replace multi-purpose area - implementation decision. Start simple: toggle replaces current view.

userStories.title: Expiration selector with [ and ] keys
acceptanceCriteria: Add '[' keybinding: previous expiration date
Add ']' keybinding: next expiration date
Cycle through available expirations for current ticker
Wrap around: after last expiration, wrap to first (and vice versa)
Update header to show current expiration date
Fetch and display new chain when expiration changes
Show loading state while fetching new chain
Bindings only active when options panel is focused/visible
Store _expirations list and _current_expiration_index in panel
Test: cycling through expirations updates display
Test: wrap-around works correctly
Update help_screen.py with [ ] keybindings
userStories.notes: Using [ ] instead of Tab to avoid conflict with app-level Tab for panel switching. Brackets are intuitive for 'previous/next' navigation.

userStories.title: Calls/Puts toggle with c/p keys
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'c' keybinding: show calls (when in options panel)
Add 'p' keybinding: show puts (when in options panel)
Current view (calls/puts) shown in header: 'CALLS' or 'PUTS'
Toggle is instant - no refetch needed, data already loaded
Reset selected row to 0 when switching between calls/puts
Store _show_calls: bool = True in panel (True = calls, False = puts)
c/p keys only active when options panel has focus
Test: 'c' switches to calls view
Test: 'p' switches to puts view
Test: selection resets on switch
Update help_screen.py with c/p keybindings
userStories.notes: Simple toggle between two pre-loaded lists. No network request needed since option_chain() returns both calls and puts at once.

yfinanceOptionsAPI.get_expirations: ticker = yf.Ticker(symbol); dates = ticker.options  # tuple of 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings

dataclassDesign.OptionContract: Immutable dataclass with all numeric fields (use 0.0 for None/NaN)
dataclassDesign.OptionsChain: Contains ticker, expiration, and separate lists for calls and puts
dataclassDesign.OptionsError: Similar to StockError - ticker and error_message fields

panelStateManagement.empty: No ticker selected - show 'Select a ticker to view options'
panelStateManagement.success: Display options table with current chain data
panelStateManagement.error: No options available - show error message

navigationDesign.j_k: Move selection up/down in options table (within current calls/puts)
navigationDesign.brackets: [ previous expiration, ] next expiration (cycles through dates)
navigationDesign.c_p: c = show calls, p = show puts (instant toggle, no refetch)
navigationDesign.o: Toggle options panel visibility at app level
